verdict.rationale: Testing in a sandbox is a fair question for a SaaS product-analytics platform with APIs and an MCP server, but the evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, staging or test subscription isolated from production data. Session-replay masking and Pendo Validate (idea testing with real users) are related features, not sandbox isolation, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
